Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
An Ordinance
further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th June, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(IX)/98, dated
8-6-1998.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Development
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Lahore Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Addition of sections 11A and 11B in Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
An Ordinance
further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th June, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(IX)/98, dated
8-6-1998.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:---
2. Addition of sections 11A
and 11B in Act XXX of 1975.-------In the Lahore Development Authority Act,
1975 (XXX of 1975) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after section 11
the following new sections shall be added:--
"11-A. Notwithstanding
anything contained in section 11 or any, rules or regulations made or orders or
instructions issued thereunder or contained in the terms and conditions of service
of any person employed or serving under the Authority or an Agency the
Authority may at any time retire or remove from such service any person after
informing him in writing of the grounds on which such action is proposed to be
taken and giving him an opportunity of showing cause in writing against the
action within a period of 14 days.
11-B. Liability for loss.--Any
person employed by or serving under the Authority or an Agency charged with the
administration of the affairs of the Authority or an Agency or acting on behalf
of the Authority or an Agency or acting under a contract with the Authority or
an Agency who is responsible for the loss, waste, misappropriation or
misapplication of any money or property Authority or an Agency which is a
direct consequence negligence or misconduct in the discharge of his duties
shall be liable to pay the loss suffered the Authority or an Agency on the same
being determined by the Authority after giving the person concerned a
reasonable opportunity of being heard.
sections.punishment:
shall be liable to pay the loss suffered the Authority or an Agency on the same
being determined by the Authority after giving the person concerned a
reasonable opportunity of being heard.

sections.shortTitle: Lahore Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 34 of Act XXX of 1975

ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE IX OF 1998
An Ordinance
further to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
8th June, 1998]
No. Legis.-3(IX)/98, dated
8-6-1998.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:---
3. Amendment of section 34 of
Act XXX of 1975.----In the said Act in section 34 the following subsection
(4-A) shall be added:--
(4-A) Whoever negligently does
any act in the performance of his duties which causes loss of money or property
to the Authority or an Agency shall be liable to be punished with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to two years."
sections.punishment:
shall be liable to be punished with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to two years.
